cards.text: Abraham's chief servant came looking for a wife for Isaac, Abraham's son, and he's just met Rebekah at the spring. Now Rebekah RUNS home and tells her mother's household everything. That's no casual stroll, friend, that's the whole family group chat blowing up at once.
Rebekah has a brother named Laban. And Laban RUSHES out to the man at the spring.

cards.question: Before Laban heads out to the spring, he sees something new on his sister Rebekah: a ring and ___.

cards.text: As soon as Laban sees that jewelry, he's out the door, and he finds the man standing by the camels near the spring. Nobody moves that fast for me unless the oven timer goes off.

cards.question: Laban invites Abraham's servant to come inside. What does Laban call him?
Laban tells Abraham's servant he hasn't had time to get anything ready for him or his camels.

cards.text: So the man comes to the house, the camels get unloaded and fed, and there's water to wash his feet and his companions' feet. Then a meal is set in front of him, and friend, after a trip like that, I'd be face-first in it before anybody said grace.

cards.question: With the meal in front of him, Abraham's servant eats first and saves the talking for later.

cards.text: Laban says, “Please speak,” and the man starts with who he is: Abraham's servant. Then he tells them the LORD has greatly blessed Abraham with sheep and cattle, silver and gold, servants, camels and donkeys.

cards.question: Abraham's servant says Sarah gave Abraham a son in her old age. What has Abraham given that son?

cards.text: Then he tells them about an oath Abraham made him swear. It's all about where Isaac's wife can come from.

cards.question: Abraham made his servant swear not to take a wife for Isaac from the daughters of the ___.
So where did Abraham send his servant to find a wife for Isaac instead?

answers.text: To his own family and relatives
To the great cities of Egypt
To the towns along the Jordan

cards.text: The servant says he asked Abraham, ‘What if the woman will not come back with me?’ And Abraham told him the LORD would send His angel with him and make his journey a success.

cards.question: Abraham told his servant that if the family refused to give her, he would be released from his oath.

cards.text: Then he walks them through his day at the spring: his prayer, and Rebekah showing up before he'd even finished praying, offering to water his camels too. Ask me how MY day went and you get the whole batch, crumbs and all, so I respect this man.

cards.question: Abraham's servant says he asked Rebekah one question before he put the ring and bracelets on her. What was it?

cards.text: Then, he says, he bowed down and worshiped the LORD. The LORD led him on the right road, straight to the granddaughter of Abraham's brother.

cards.question: Abraham's servant finishes by asking the family for their answer. If they say no, what will he do?

cards.text: Abraham's servant has told the whole story and asked for an answer. Now Laban and Bethuel, Rebekah's father, speak up, and I'm sitting here holding my breath like it's the last batch in the oven.

cards.question: Laban and Bethuel answer Abraham's servant. Where do they say all this came from?

cards.text: They tell him, “Rebekah is here before you. Take her and go,” and Abraham's servant bows down to the ground before the LORD. This man hears good news and hits the FLOOR, and I love him for it.

cards.question: Abraham's servant brings out jewels of silver and gold and clothing. Who gets gifts?

answers.text: Rebekah and her brother and mother
Rebekah and her father and nurse
Her nurse and her servant girls

cards.text: They eat, drink and spend the night. Next morning the servant is up and ready: “Send me on my way to my master.”

cards.question: Rebekah's brother and mother have a different idea. They want her to stay with them ___ days or so.
Abraham's servant agrees to stay the extra days before heading home.

cards.text: So the family settles it another way. They'll call the girl and ask her opinion.

cards.question: They call Rebekah and ask her, “Will you go with this man?” What does she say?

cards.text: Three words, and I take longer than that to pick a topping. So they send their sister Rebekah on her way with her nurse, Abraham's servant and his men.

cards.question: Before Rebekah leaves, her family blesses her. What do they wish for her?

answers.text: To be the mother of thousands
To come back home again soon
To be rich in land and gold

cards.text: And the blessing keeps going: “May your offspring possess the gates of their enemies.” Friend, that's not a send-off, that's a whole PARADE.

cards.question: Rebekah sets out on the camels with no servant girls of her own.

cards.text: Meanwhile, Isaac has just come back from Beer-lahai-roi to the Negev, where he's living. Early in the evening, he heads out for some quiet time with his thoughts.

cards.question: Early in the evening, Isaac goes out to the ___ to ___.

cards.text: Isaac looks up and sees camels coming, and Rebekah looks up and sees Isaac. She gets down off her camel, and friend, THIS is the slow-motion part of the movie.

cards.question: Rebekah asks the servant who the man in the field is. He answers, “It is my master,” and Rebekah reacts. What does she do?

answers.text: She covers herself with her veil
She runs out to meet him
She climbs back on her camel

cards.text: Then the servant tells Isaac all that he had done. If it's anything like the version he gave at Laban's house, Isaac better pull up a chair.

cards.question: Isaac brings Rebekah into the tent of his father Abraham.

cards.text: Isaac takes Rebekah as his wife, and Isaac loved her and was comforted after his mother's death. We'll leave it right there for now, friend, because Abraham's story isn't finished yet.

findings.problem: The wrong answer "robes" is not false everywhere in the passage. In Genesis 24:53 the servant gives Rebekah "articles of clothing," so Rebekah does end up with new clothing on her. Replace it with an item she never receives in the passage.

rule.text: Each wrong answer must be false anywhere in the passage, not just at that moment.

findings.problem: Genesis 24:30 names two triggers: Laban saw the ring and bracelets AND heard Rebekah's words. The card keeps only one: "As soon as Laban sees that jewelry, he's out the door." The joke that follows leans on it too. Together they make the jewelry the reason Laban goes out, which the text doesn't say on its own.

rule.text: He never adds why someone did, said or thought something unless the text says why.

findings.problem: The wrong answer "Her nurse and her servant girls" tells the baker that Rebekah has servant girls. Card 13 then asks whether Rebekah sets out with no servant girls of her own (False), so this card gives that answer away.

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

findings.problem: The card says Isaac "heads out for some quiet time with his thoughts." That is a paraphrase of "meditate," which is the second blank on card 15. It gives the answer away.

rule.text: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

findings.problem: The card says Isaac "has just come back from Beer-lahai-roi to the Negev." Genesis 24:62 says he "had just returned from Beer-lahai-roi, for he was living in the Negev." The card turns the Negev into the place he returned to, a connection the text leaves open.

rule.text: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
